description:
Write a file. mode=create (makes the parent folders too, fails if the path exists), overwrite, or append. create_dirs=true creates parent folders (implied by mode=create).
Use when: you create a file (with its folder, e.g. `a/b/c.txt`), replace one entirely, or append. expected_sha256 refuses the write if the file changed since you read it.
Avoid when: you change a few lines (edit_file). overwrite is immediate and not undoable: snapshot first when the file is not in git.
Output: action (created|overwritten|appended), bytes_written, sha256_after. mode=create on an existing path gives conflict.

create_dirs.description: true creates missing parent directories (implied by mode=create).

expected_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file's current full content. The write is refused if the file on disk differs. Use sha256_after from your last write/edit of this file; read_file's sha256 only matches when the whole file was returned.

mode.description: Default overwrite. create makes the parent folders and the file (fails if the path already exists); append adds to the end.

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative ('.' = root); absolute/.. outside it rejected.
